name: Somchai Wisut
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, repairing scooters in his family's shop in Bangkok. His knack for understanding mechanics quickly led him to racing bikes, and eventually cars. Although he was a competent racer, his real passion lay in the intricate details of vehicle construction and modification. He spent years honing his skills, working in various workshops, picking up the nuances of fabrication. 

Somchai is known for his methodical approach and unwavering focus. He believes in precision and quality, ensuring every component meets the highest standards. He strives to combine traditional techniques with cutting-edge innovation. While some see him as a bit of a loner, his dedication to his craft and his innovative solutions make him a highly valuable asset to any team.

physical.description: A wiry man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his tools before starting a project, regardless of their initial state.
Has a lucky wrench that he refuses to let anyone else use.
Listens to traditional Thai folk music through headphones while working.
